units.title: 六冲卦变六合，不看用神径直断吉：占婚姻先吴越而后朱陈，占夫妻先参商而终合好

rule.yi: 六冲卦变成六合卦（比如乾为天，外卦三爻都动，乾变成泰），别的合都要用神旺才算吉，只有这一种不看用神，直接断吉。占婚姻，起初像吴国和越国那样互为仇敌，后来才结成朱陈两家那样的亲家；占夫妻，起初像参星和商星那样见不到面，最终和好；占妻儿，离散了的终会团聚。书里的例子：未月丁巳日占一门已经悔婚的亲事还能不能成，得离之旅；书里说这一卦从来难以断吉，但屡次验过，六冲变合是散了又聚、离了必合，这门婚事一定还成，次年三月果然成婚。
rule.en: A Six-clash hexagram changing into a Six-combine one (for example Qian wei Tian with all three outer lines moving, so that Qian changes into Tai): every other kind of combination is auspicious only when the Subject is strong, but this one is judged auspicious without looking at the Subject at all. For a marriage it means first foes like the states of Wu and Yue, then in-laws like the families of Zhu and Chen; for husband and wife, first as far apart as the stars Shen and Shang, in the end reconciled; for wife and children, those scattered will in the end come together. The book's case: in the Wei month on a Dingsi day someone asked whether a marriage already called off could still be made and got Li changing into Lü; the book says this hexagram has never been easy to judge auspicious, but it has proved true many times: a Six-clash turning to combine is scattering and then gathering, parting and then surely joining, so the marriage would surely still be made, and it was, in the third month of the next year.

zh: 六冲卦变六合者五也。
如占得乾为天卦，乃八纯六冲之卦，若外卦三爻俱动，变为乾之泰卦，谓之六冲而变六合是也。
yi: 六冲卦变成六合卦，是第五种合。
比如占得乾为天卦，它是八纯卦，也是六冲卦，如果外卦三爻都动，乾变成泰卦，这就叫六冲而变六合。
en: A Six-clash hexagram changing into a Six-combine one is the fifth kind of combination.

For example, if Qian wei Tian is obtained, it is a pure eight-palace hexagram and a Six-clash hexagram; if all three lines of the outer trigram move and Qian changes into Tai, this is called a Six-clash changing into a Six-combine.

zh: 余又验其六冲卦变六合者，如未月丁巳日(旬空：子丑)，占已悔婚，还可成否？
得“离之旅”
yi: 我又验证过六冲卦变六合的例子：未月丁巳日（旬空子、丑），占一门已经悔婚的亲事还能不能成？
得离卦变旅卦。
en: I have also tested a Six-clash hexagram changing into a Six-combine one: in the Wei month on a Dingsi day (void: Zi and Chou), I divined whether a marriage already called off could still be made.
The hexagram was Li changing into Lü.

zh: 此卦从来难以吉断，因得屡验，六冲变合，散而复聚，离而必合，此婚一定还成。
果于次年三月仍复成婚。
yi: 这一卦从来难以断吉，但因为屡次验过：六冲变合，是散了又聚、离了必合，这门婚事一定还成。
果然在第二年三月又成了婚。
en: This hexagram has never been easy to judge auspicious, but I have proved it repeatedly: a Six-clash turning to combine is scattering and then gathering, parting and then surely joining, so this marriage will surely still be made.
It came true: in the third month of the next year the wedding was held after all.

zh: 按：诸合皆以用神旺者为吉，独此六冲卦变六合者，不看用神，竟以吉断。
占婚姻，先吴越而后朱陈；
占夫妻，先参商而终合好；
占功名，始则艰难，终须荣显；
占求谋，先难后易；
占身命，先否后泰；
占风水，巧处奇逢；
占家宅，先衰后盛；
占妻儿，抛散者终须会合；
占田园，卖出者，仍旧归来。
yi: 按：各种合，都是用神旺才算吉，只有这种六冲卦变六合的，不看用神，直接断吉。
占婚姻，起初像吴国和越国那样互为仇敌，后来才结成朱陈两家那样的姻亲；
占夫妻，起初像参星和商星那样见不到面，最终和好；
占功名，起初艰难，最终必定荣耀显达；
占求谋：先难，后易；
占身命，先像否卦那样闭塞，后来像泰卦那样通泰；
占风水，在巧合之处遇上好地；
占家宅，先衰败后兴盛；
占妻儿，离散了的终究会团聚；
占田园，卖出去的，仍旧回到手里。
en: Note: in every kind of combination it is auspicious only when the Subject is strong; this one alone, a Six-clash hexagram changing into a Six-combine one, does not look at the Subject and is simply judged auspicious.
For a marriage: first foes like Wu and Yue, then in-laws like the families of Zhu and Chen;
for husband and wife: first as far apart as the stars Shen and Shang, in the end reconciled;
for office and fame: hard at first, in the end sure to bring honor;
for a venture: hard first, easy afterwards;
for one's person and fate: first blocked like Pi, then at ease like Tai;
for geomancy: a good site found by a lucky chance;
for the household: first decline, then prosperity;
for wife and children: those who were scattered will in the end be reunited;
for fields and gardens: what was sold will come back again.

note.yi: 「吴越」是春秋时互相为敌的两个国家；「朱陈」是徐州一个村子里的两个姓，世代通婚，后来「朱陈」成了结亲的代称；「参商」是天上两颗星，一出一没，永远不同时出现，比喻亲人见不到面。例中的排盘图这里不收。
note.en: Wu and Yue were two states that were enemies in the Spring and Autumn period; Zhu and Chen were the two clans of a village in Xuzhou who intermarried generation after generation, so 'Zhu-Chen' came to mean a marriage alliance; Shen and Shang are two stars, one rising as the other sets, never seen together, and stand for kin who cannot meet. The chart of the case is not included here.

units.title: 凡得诸合，诸占皆吉、占婚必成，但要用神有气，用神失陷合也无济；吉事逢合必就，凶事逢合难结

rule.yi: 凡是得到各种合（日月合爻、爻与爻合、爻动化合、卦逢六合等），占什么都算吉，占婚姻一定成。但必须用神有气才相宜；用神如果失陷，合了也没有用。卜书说，万事得三合或六合，事情一定长久、有始有终；不过好事碰上合，事情一定做成，坏事碰上合，事情就难以了结。
rule.en: Whenever any kind of combination is obtained (a line combining with the Day or Month, a line with a line, a moving line changing into a combination, the hexagram itself being a Six-combine, and so on), every kind of divination counts it auspicious, and in a marriage divination the match is sure to be made. But it is fitting only when the Subject has qi; if the Subject is lost or fallen, the combination does not help. The divination books say that with a three-harmony or Six-combine in everything, matters will surely last, with a beginning and an end; but a good matter meeting a combination is sure to be made, whereas an ill matter meeting a combination is hard to bring to an end.

zh: 卦逢六合者四也。
如占得天地否卦，内外六爻自相和合者是也，不动亦是。
yi: 卦逢六合，是第四种合。
比如占得天地否卦，内外六爻自己互相和合的就是，不动也算。
en: A hexagram meeting Six-combine is the fourth kind of combination.
For example, if Pi (Heaven over Earth) is obtained and the six lines inside and outside combine with one another, that is it; it counts even if none of them moves.

zh: 凡得诸合，诸占皆以为吉。
占名名成，占利利就，占婚必成，占身发迹，占宅兴旺，占风水聚气藏风，占求谋遂心合意。
然必用神有气相宜，用若失陷无济。
卜书云：万事若得三六合，诸事必得久远，有始有终。
然吉事逢之，事之必就，凶事逢之，事之难结。
yi: 凡是得到各种合，占什么都算吉。
占功名，功名就成；占求利，利就得到；占婚姻，一定成；占自身，会发迹；占住宅，兴旺；占风水，聚气藏风；占求谋，称心如意。
不过必须用神有气才相宜，用神如果失陷，合也没有用。
卜书说：万事如果得到三合、六合，各种事一定能长久，有始有终。
不过吉事遇上合，事一定做成；凶事遇上合，事就难以了结。
en: Whenever any combination is obtained, every kind of divination counts it auspicious.

For fame, fame is made; for gain, gain is won; for marriage, it is sure to be made; for one's person, one rises; for the house, it prospers; for geomancy, the qi gathers and the wind is held; for a venture, it goes as the heart wishes.
But it is fitting only when the Subject has qi; if the Subject is lost or fallen, the combination does not help.
The divination books say: if in everything one gets a three-harmony or a Six-combine, all matters will surely last long, with a beginning and an end.
Yet a good matter meeting a combination is sure to be made, while an ill matter meeting a combination is hard to bring to an end.

note.yi: 这一章开头把合分成六种：日月合爻、爻与爻合、爻动化合、卦逢六合、六冲卦变六合、六合卦变六合。第四种的原文放在最前面，第五种另见 LY.MARRY.ZS.27。「合起」「合绊」「合好」「化扶」四个名词在这一章里另有解释，这里不收。
note.en: The chapter opens by dividing combinations into six kinds: the Day or Month combining with a line, a line with a line, a moving line changing into a combination, a hexagram meeting Six-combine, a Six-clash hexagram changing into a Six-combine one, and a Six-combine hexagram changing into another. The text of the fourth kind is given first; the fifth is at LY.MARRY.ZS.27. Four terms the chapter explains further (a combination that raises, one that binds, one that makes friends, one that helps by change) are not included here.

units.title: 爻逢六合已是吉兆，动而又变六合终始佳祥：占婚姻白头相守；宜合则吉不宜合则凶，用神旺临日月吉上加吉，用神受克更为凶兆

rule.yi: 爻逢六合，已经是吉兆；动了又变成六合，从头到尾都好。占婚姻，就是白头相守。合是吉是凶，要看这件事适不适合聚合：婚姻、合伙、功名、钱财、兄弟同居这类事遇合是吉，诉讼、冤仇、犹疑的怪事、生产遇合反而不利（怀孕倒是安稳）。以上各种占问，用神旺又临日月的，吉上加吉；用神被克，更是凶兆。
rule.en: A line meeting Six-combine is already an auspicious sign, and if it moves and changes into a Six-combine again it is fortunate from start to finish. For a marriage that is keeping company to white hair. Whether a combination is good depends on whether the matter suits gathering: marriage, partnership, office, money and brothers living together are helped by a combination, whereas a lawsuit, a grudge, a doubtful or strange matter and childbirth are hindered by it (pregnancy, however, is secure). In all of these, where the Subject is strong and is the Day or Month itself it is good and better still; where the Subject is controlled it is an even worse omen.

zh: 爻逢六合，已为吉兆，动而又变六合，终始佳祥。
yi: 爻逢六合，已经是吉兆；动了又变成六合，从头到尾都好。
en: A line meeting Six-combine is already an auspicious sign; if it moves and again changes into a Six-combine, it is fortunate from start to finish.

zh: 占风水，百代簪缨；
占宅舍，千秋基业；
占婚姻，白头相守；
占伙计，管鲍雷陈；
占功名，仕路亨通；
占财帛，聚积如山；
占兄弟，累世同居；
占学艺，始终成就；
占修炼，指日丹成。
宜合吉，不宜合凶。
以上诸占，用神旺临日月者，吉而又吉。
惟占讼狱不利，冤仇难解；
及犹疑怪事，终不开心。
占孕胎安，占产难生。
再若用神受克，更为凶兆。
yi: 占风水，世世代代出官宦；
占住宅，千年不倒的基业；
占婚姻，白头到老，相伴相守；
占合伙的人，像管仲和鲍叔牙、雷义和陈重那样交情深厚；
占功名，仕途顺畅；
占钱财，积聚得像山一样；
占兄弟，世世代代住在一起；
占学手艺，始终有成就；
占修炼，不日就能丹成。
适合聚合的事，遇合是吉；不适合聚合的事，遇合是凶。
以上各种占问，用神旺又临日月的，吉上加吉。
只有占诉讼不利，冤仇难以化解；
还有犹豫不决的事和怪事，始终不开心。
占怀孕，胎安稳；占生产，难以生下。
再如果用神被克，就更是凶兆。
en: For geomancy: generations of officials;
for a dwelling: an estate that lasts a thousand years;
for marriage: keeping company to white hair;
for a partner: friends as devoted as Guan Zhong and Bao Shuya, or Lei Yi and Chen Zhong;
for office and fame: a smooth official career;
for money: piled up like a mountain;
for brothers: living together through the generations;
for learning a craft: achievement from start to finish;
for spiritual cultivation: the elixir is made within days.
Where a combination suits the matter it is auspicious; where it does not suit the matter it is ill.
In all the divinations above, where the Subject is strong and is the Day or Month itself, it is good and better still.
Only a lawsuit is unfavorable, a grudge hard to undo;
and in a matter of doubt or of strange happenings one never feels at ease.
For pregnancy: the child is secure; for childbirth: hard to deliver.
And if the Subject is controlled, it is an even worse omen.

note.yi: 这一段紧接在「六冲卦变六合」那一条的后面（LY.MARRY.ZS.27），第一句「爻逢六合」承的是那里最后一句。「管鲍雷陈」是四个人：管仲、鲍叔牙，雷义、陈重，都是古书里交情极深的朋友。「占兄弟」的兄弟指同胞兄弟，不是六亲里的兄弟爻。
note.en: This passage follows directly on the Six-clash-changing-into-Six-combine entry (LY.MARRY.ZS.27), and its first sentence takes up the last sentence there. 'Guan, Bao, Lei, Chen' are four men: Guan Zhong and Bao Shuya, Lei Yi and Chen Zhong, friends famous in old books for their devotion. 'Divining brothers' means brothers by blood, not the Peer line among the six relations.

units.chapter_en: Chapter on Reversed and Hidden Chant
units.title: 反吟卦内外不安、成而败败而成：占婚姻反复难成，允了又悔；但应爻临财动而生世，仍在生扶之月成

rule.yi: 反吟（内卦或外卦动变之后，每一爻的地支都变成和自己相冲的地支，例如丑亥酉变成未巳卯）主里外不安，事情成了又败、败了又成。占婚姻，就是反反复复，难以成功：先答应又反悔。书中一例：巳月戊子日占婚事对方答不答应，得恒之晋，内卦反吟，断为答应了又后悔；问将来能不能成，断为应爻是财爻、动而生世，八九月间一定成，果然酉月成婚。
rule.en: A Reversed Chant (after moving and changing, the branch of every line of the inner or outer trigram becomes the one that clashes with it, for example Chou-Hai-You becoming Wei-Si-Mao) means unease within and without and things that succeed and then fail, and fail and then succeed. For a marriage it means going back and forth and being hard to make: agreed and then regretted. The book's case: in the Si month on a Wuzi day, asked whether a marriage would be agreed to, the hexagram was Heng changing into Jin; the inner trigram was a Reversed Chant, and the judgment was agreeing and then regretting; asked whether it would be made in the end, the judgment was that the Other line is Wealth and moves to generate the Self line, so it would surely be made in the eighth or ninth month, and it was made in the You month.

zh: 内卦反吟，内则不安；
外卦反吟，外则不宁；
内外反吟，内外不安之象。
皆主成而败、败而成，有而即无、无而即有，得而失、失而得，来而去、去而来，散而聚、聚而散，动而思静、静而思动。
yi: 内卦反吟，内部就不安稳；
外卦反吟，外部就不安宁；
内外卦都反吟，是里外都不安稳的样子。
都主成了又败、败了又成，有了就没有、没有又有，得了又失、失了又得，来了又去、去了又来，散了又聚、聚了又散，动了想静、静了想动。
en: If the inner trigram is a Reversed Chant, things within are uneasy;
if the outer trigram is a Reversed Chant, things without are unsettled;
if inner and outer are both a Reversed Chant, it is a picture of unease within and without.

All of it means success then failure and failure then success, having then not having and not having then having, gaining then losing and losing then gaining, coming then going and going then coming, scattering then gathering and gathering then scattering, moving and longing for stillness and still and longing to move.

zh: 占婚姻，反复难成。
yi: 占婚姻：反反复复，难以成功。
en: For marriage: it goes back and forth and is hard to make.

zh: 如：巳月戊子日(旬空：午未)，占婚允否，得“恒之晋”
yi: 例：巳月戊子日（旬空午、未），占婚事对方答不答应，得恒卦变晋卦。
en: A case: Si month, Wuzi day (void: Wu and Wei); a divination on whether the marriage would be agreed to; the hexagram was Heng changing into Jin.

zh: 内卦反吟，翻覆更变，允而复悔之象。
彼曰：诚如所断，将来成否？
余曰：应爻临财，动而生世，八九月间必成。
果于酉月成之，乃应世爻值月，又冲去卯木之月也。
yi: 内卦反吟，翻来覆去地更改，是答应了又后悔的样子。
他说：确实像你断的那样，将来能不能成？
我说：应爻是财爻，动了去生世爻，八九月间一定成。
果然在酉月成了，这是应在世爻当值的月份，又是冲去卯木的月份。
en: The inner trigram is a Reversed Chant, turning over and changing again and again: the picture of agreeing and then regretting.
He said: it is just as you judge; will it be made in the end?
I said: the Other line is Wealth and it moves to generate the Self line, so it will surely be made in the eighth or ninth month.
It was indeed made in the You month, answering in the month when the Self line rules, which also clashes away the Mao Wood.

note.yi: 「反吟」怎么算，书里在这一章前面用卦例讲（乾变坤、升变观、观变坤、巽变观等），排盘图这里不收。恒之晋的例子里，下三爻的丑亥酉变成未巳卯，每一爻都变成与自己相冲的地支，所以是「内卦反吟」。这个例子和 LY.MARRY.ZS.09 的「反吟卦变，翻覆难成」是同一个意思，例子多告诉我们一件事：反吟不等于不成，只是先反复，应爻临财又动而生世的话，还是成了。
note.en: How a Reversed Chant is counted is taught earlier in this chapter by cases (Qian into Kun, Sheng into Guan, Guan into Kun, Xun into Guan and others), whose charts are not included here. In the Heng-into-Jin case the lower three lines Chou, Hai and You turn into Wei, Si and Mao, each clashing with itself, so it is an 'inner trigram Reversed Chant'. The case says the same as LY.MARRY.ZS.09 ('a Reversed Chant change flips back and forth and is hard to accomplish') and adds one thing: a Reversed Chant does not mean it never happens, only that it first goes back and forth, and if the Other line is Wealth and moves to generate the Self line the match is still made.

units.chapter_en: Chapter on Reversed and Hidden Chant
units.title: 伏吟卦内外忧郁呻吟：占婚姻忧而不乐

rule.yi: 伏吟（卦变之后每一爻的地支还是原来那个，例如无妄变大壮，戌仍是戌、申仍是申）主里外忧郁呻吟：内卦伏吟，里面不舒服；外卦伏吟，外面不安宁。占婚姻，是忧愁而不快乐。它比反吟轻，因为反吟有冲有克，伏吟没有，要看用神旺衰（见 LY.MARRY.ZS.32）。
rule.en: A Hidden Chant (after the hexagram changes, every line still has the branch it had before; for example Wuwang into Dazhuang, where Xu stays Xu and Shen stays Shen) means gloom and groaning within and without: an inner trigram that is a Hidden Chant is ill at ease within, an outer one is unsettled without. For a marriage it means worried and unhappy. It is lighter than a Reversed Chant, because the Reversed Chant has clash and control and the Hidden Chant has neither; what matters is whether the Subject is strong (see LY.MARRY.ZS.32).

zh: 伏吟卦者，有内外伏吟，如无妄变大壮
yi: 伏吟卦，有内外卦都伏吟的，比如无妄变大壮。
en: A Hidden Chant hexagram can be one where inner and outer are both Hidden Chant, such as Wuwang changing into Dazhuang.

zh: 内外伏吟者，内外忧郁呻吟之象。
又有内卦动变伏吟，则内呻吟；
外卦动变伏吟，则外不宁。
yi: 内外卦都伏吟的，是里外忧郁呻吟的样子。
还有内卦动变伏吟的，里面就呻吟；
外卦动变伏吟的，外面就不安宁。
en: Where inner and outer are both a Hidden Chant, it is a picture of gloom and groaning within and without.
Where the inner trigram moves and changes into a Hidden Chant, there is groaning within;
where the outer trigram moves and changes into a Hidden Chant, things without are unsettled.

zh: 占婚姻，忧而不乐；
yi: 占婚姻：忧愁而不快乐；
en: For marriage: worried and unhappy;

note.yi: 原文「伏吟卦者，有内外伏吟，如无妄变大壮」这一句没有句号，后面就是排盘图，这里只引这一句。无妄变大壮里，壬戌变庚戌、壬申变庚申、庚辰变甲辰、庚寅变甲寅，地支都没变，所以叫伏吟。
note.en: The sentence 'a Hidden Chant hexagram can be one with inner and outer both Hidden Chant, such as Wuwang into Dazhuang' has no full stop in the text and is followed by a chart, and only this sentence is quoted. In Wuwang into Dazhuang, Ren-Xu turns into Geng-Xu, Ren-Shen into Geng-Shen, Geng-Chen into Jia-Chen and Geng-Yin into Jia-Yin: the branches do not change, which is why it is called a Hidden Chant.

units.chapter_en: Chapter on Reversed and Hidden Chant
units.title: 反吟有冲有克重于伏吟，两者都要看用神旺衰：伏吟用神旺相则冲开之年月志伸，休囚则不过忧郁；不可一概以反伏为畏途

rule.yi: 伏吟和反吟比，反吟有冲有克，用神再受克，祸不轻。伏吟的卦，用神旺相，在冲开的年月，心志得以伸展；用神休囚，在冲开的年月，不过是忧郁罢了。李我平说：《易林补遗》讲「爻有伏吟不吉」「卦有反吟最凶」，是不看用神的旺衰，竟把反吟、伏吟当成要躲开的路；野鹤的办法是看用神，教人多么透彻明快。
rule.en: Compared with the Reversed Chant, the Hidden Chant is the lighter, since the Reversed Chant has clash and control, and when the Subject is controlled the misfortune is not slight. In a Hidden Chant hexagram, if the Subject is strong, then in the year or month when it is clashed open one's aims are carried out; if the Subject is resting or trapped, then in that year or month there is only gloom. Li Woping says the Yilin Buyi's 'a line with a Hidden Chant is not auspicious' and 'a hexagram with a Reversed Chant is the worst' do not look at whether the Subject is strong or weak and simply treat Reversed and Hidden Chant as roads to be dreaded; the Old Man of Yehe's way, judging by the Subject, is thoroughly clear and incisive.

zh: 按：伏吟较之反吟，反吟有冲有克，用神受克，得祸匪轻。
伏吟之卦，用神旺相，冲开之年月，其志则伸；
用神休囚，冲开之年月，忧郁而已。
yi: 按：伏吟比起反吟来（要轻些），反吟有冲有克，用神再受克，招来的祸不轻。
伏吟的卦，用神旺相，在冲开的年月，心志得以伸展；
用神休囚，在冲开的年月，也不过是忧郁罢了。
en: Note: the Hidden Chant against the Reversed Chant: the Reversed Chant has both clash and control, and when the Subject is controlled the misfortune it brings is not slight.
In a Hidden Chant hexagram, if the Subject is strong, then in the year or month when it is clashed open one's aims are carried out;
if the Subject is resting or trapped, then in the year or month when it is clashed open there is only gloom.

zh: 李我平曰：《易林补遗》有曰，爻有伏吟不吉，术者未闻，卦有反吟最凶，卜家谁觉？
是不看用神之衰旺，竟以反伏为畏途也。
今野鹤此论，以比之井卦，世逢冲克，事反伏，身受其殃。
临之中孚，世官得地，虽反伏，官连迁转。
教人之法，何等透彻明快。
yi: 李我平说：《易林补遗》讲过：「爻有伏吟不吉，术者没听说过；卦有反吟最凶，卜家有谁察觉？」
这是不看用神的旺衰，竟把反吟、伏吟当成要躲开的险路。
现在野鹤这番议论，拿比卦变井卦来说，世爻遇冲遇克，事情反复伏藏，人就受害。
临卦变中孚卦，世爻和官星都得地，虽然反吟、伏吟，官职却接连升迁调动。
这样教人的办法，多么透彻明快。
en: Li Woping says: the Yilin Buyi states: 'A line with a Hidden Chant is not auspicious, and no practitioner has heard of it; a hexagram with a Reversed Chant is the worst, and which diviner has noticed it?'
This does not look at whether the Subject is strong or weak, and simply treats Reversed and Hidden Chant as a road to be dreaded.
Now this argument of the Old Man of Yehe, taking Bi changing into Jing: the Self line meets clash and control, the matter is reversed and hidden, and the person suffers the calamity.
Lin changing into Zhongfu: the Self line and the Pressure line are well placed, and though reversed and hidden, the office is promoted and transferred one after another.
What a thoroughly clear and incisive way of teaching people.

dispute.yi: 《易林补遗》把反吟、伏吟一概当成凶：「爻有伏吟不吉」「卦有反吟最凶」，别处还说「伏吟反吟犯者，急须回避」（见该书第 54、332 行）；增删卜易看用神旺衰：反吟重在有冲有克、用神受克，伏吟用神旺相时冲开之年月反而志伸。李我平明确站在野鹤一边。他引的《易林补遗》原文是「术者未开」「星家谁觉」，和这里的「术者未闻」「卜家谁觉」各差一个字。
dispute.en: The Yilin Buyi takes Reversed and Hidden Chant as ill without condition: 'a line with a Hidden Chant is not auspicious', 'a hexagram with a Reversed Chant is the worst', and elsewhere 'those who meet Hidden or Reversed Chant must hurry to avoid it' (lines 54 and 332 of that book); the Zengshan Buyi looks at whether the Subject is strong: a Reversed Chant is heavy through clash and control and a controlled Subject, and a Hidden Chant with a strong Subject actually carries out its aims in the year or month it is clashed open. Li Woping sides plainly with the Old Man of Yehe. The Yilin Buyi's own words are 'no practitioner has opened it' and 'which astrologer has noticed', each differing by one character from the 'has heard' and 'which diviner' quoted here.

note.yi: 李我平提到的两个例子在同一章里：比之井是占跟着做官的人上任（书中第 2405 行起），临之中孚是占升迁（第 2450 行起）。这两卦都不是婚姻，放在这里是因为它们是本章讲「反伏不可一概畏」的依据。
note.en: The two cases Li Woping mentions are in the same chapter: Bi into Jing is a divination on going with an official to his post, and Lin into Zhongfu is a divination on promotion. Neither is about marriage; they are given here because they are this chapter's grounds for saying Reversed and Hidden Chant are not to be feared without condition.

units.chapter_en: Chapter on following Pressure into the tomb
units.title: 世爻入墓只验三种（随鬼入日墓、入动墓、动而化墓），且世爻用爻休囚被克才是真；占婚姻，世旺得地或财爻有气生世，冲墓之月日成，空破休囚断难许允

rule.yi: 世爻入墓，野鹤试验后只有三种应验：世爻随鬼入日墓、世爻入动爻的墓、世爻动而化入墓。自己占的看世爻，世爻旺相的不是真入墓；替别人占的看用神，用神旺相的也不是真。只有世爻、用爻休囚被克又入墓的才是；墓被日月和动爻冲破的，也不是真，因为墓破就像网破，很容易出来。占婚姻：世爻旺、得地，或者财爻有气去生世爻，在冲开墓的月日婚事成；世爻空、破、休囚的，断定难以答应。
rule.en: Of the Self line entering a tomb, only three kinds have proved true on repeated trial: the Self line following Pressure into the Day's tomb, the Self line entering a moving line's tomb, and the Self line moving and turning into a tomb. In a divination for oneself look to the Self line, and if it is strong it is not the real thing; in a divination for another look to the Subject, and if it is strong it is not the real thing either. Only when the Self or Subject line is resting or trapped and controlled and also enters a tomb is it real; if the tomb is clashed and broken by the Day, Month or a moving line it is not real either, since a broken tomb is like a torn net and one gets out easily. In divining a marriage: if the Self line is strong and well placed, or the Wealth line has qi and generates the Self line, the match is made in the month or day that clashes the tomb open; if the Self line is Void, broken, resting or trapped, judge that consent is hard to obtain.

zh: 余因屡试而得验者，只验世爻入墓有三：一世爻随鬼入日墓，一世爻入动墓，一世爻动而化墓。
此三墓者，自占看世爻，世爻旺相者非真；
代占看用神，用神旺相者非真。
惟世爻、用爻休囚被克，而又入墓者为是也，墓神被日月动爻冲破者，亦不为真。
盖，墓破即如破网，容易而出也。
yi: 我因为屡次试验而应验了的，只有世爻入墓的三种：一是世爻随鬼入日辰的墓，二是世爻入动爻的墓，三是世爻动而化入墓。
这三种墓，自己占的看世爻，世爻旺相的不是真入墓；
替别人占的看用神，用神旺相的也不是真。
只有世爻、用爻休囚被克，又入了墓的才对；墓神被日月和动爻冲破的，也不是真。
因为墓破了就像网破了一样，很容易出来。
en: What I have found to hold after repeated trials is only three kinds of the Self line entering a tomb: the Self line following Pressure into the Day's tomb; the Self line entering a moving line's tomb; and the Self line moving and turning into a tomb.
For these three tombs: in a divination for oneself look to the Self line, and if the Self line is strong it is not the real thing;
in a divination for another look to the Subject, and if the Subject is strong it is not the real thing either.

Only when the Self or Subject line is resting or trapped and controlled and also enters a tomb is it right; if the tomb spirit is clashed and broken by the Day, Month or a moving line, that too is not the real thing.
For a broken tomb is like a torn net: one can easily get out.

zh: 占婚姻，世旺得地，及财爻有气而生世者，冲墓之月日而成；
空破休囚者，断难许允。
yi: 占婚姻：世爻旺、得地，以及财爻有气又生世爻的，在冲开墓的月日婚事成；
世爻空、破、休囚的，断定难以答应。
en: In divining a marriage: if the Self line is strong and well placed, or the Wealth line has qi and generates the Self line, the match is made in the month or day that clashes the tomb open;
if the Self line is Void, broken, resting or trapped, judge that consent is hard to obtain.

note.yi: 第二句「空破休囚者」没有写是哪一爻；同一章占功名、占求财、占身命都是「世旺得地……世若休囚空破」，所以译作世爻。同一章里其余各问（功名、求财、疾病、行人、家宅等）另有断语，这里只收婚姻一条。
note.en: The second sentence, 'where it is Void, broken, resting or trapped', does not say which line; in the same chapter the entries for fame, wealth and fortune all read 'Self strong and well placed ... if the Self line is resting, Void or broken', so it is read as the Self line. The other entries of that chapter (fame, wealth, illness, travellers, the household and others) are not included; only the one on marriage is.

units.chapter_en: The Qianjin Fu, as edited in this book
units.title: 间爻在婚姻里是媒妁：旧注说间爻动则多阻隔，野鹤说动而生合世应反得其力、只忌克世克应，觉子说婚姻以间爻为媒妁，日月冲克可解；书中例：间爻鬼化退神虽阻无力

rule.yi: 世爻和应爻中间的两爻叫间爻。《千金赋》说「事阻隔兮间发」，旧注解为：间爻一动，事多阻隔，因为它们站在世应之间，动了就拦住两家的事。觉子试验后说，把这两爻当间爻用，果然应验；要看所占何事，只有牵涉彼此两家的事才可用，婚姻里它就是媒妁（词讼里是居中说合的人，买卖里是牙行，借贷里是中保，舟车里是同载的人，交游里是帮闲，生产里是接生婆和保姆）。野鹤补充：想相亲的两方，间爻发动不能一概断作阻隔——间爻动而去生合世爻、应爻，反得这些人的力；靠近世爻的是帮我的人，靠近应爻的是扶对方的人；生我的我该亲近，克我的我该远离；最忌间爻克世、克应，事必难成：克我的，坏我的事，我被他愚弄；克应的，坏对方的事，对方被他引诱；间爻是兄弟动，害处还小，不过阻事耗财；是官鬼动，一定受连累，祸不浅。觉子又说：间爻动了，如果得到日辰月建的冲克，可以化解。书中一例：求婚，财爻持世化进神，巳火子孙动而生世，回头受克，要等午日冲去子水、午火又合世爻，婚事成，果然午日答应；有人问间爻酉金官鬼动，难道没有阻碍？答：官鬼化成退神，虽有阻碍，但没有力量。
rule.en: The two lines between the Self and Other lines are called the between lines. The Qianjin Fu says 'obstruction to the matter: the between lines move', and the old commentary explains: when the between lines move the matter meets many obstructions, since they sit between Self and Other and block the affair of the two sides when they move. Juezi tried it and says that taking these two lines as the between lines does prove true; one must look at what is divined, and only a matter between two sides can use them; in marriage they are the go-between (in a lawsuit the one who speaks between, in a sale the broker, in a loan the guarantor, on a boat or carriage the one who rides along, in friendship the hangers-on, in childbirth the midwife and nurse). The Old Man of Yehe adds: where two sides want to become close, if the between lines move do not judge it all as obstruction; if they move to generate or combine with the Self and Other lines, one gains instead from the help of such people; the one near the Self line helps me, the one near the Other line supports the other side; one that generates me I should draw near to and one that controls me I should keep away from; what is to be feared above all is a between line that controls the Self or Other line, and then the matter is sure to be hard to make: one that controls me spoils my affair and I am fooled by it, one that controls the Other line spoils the other party's affair and he is led astray; if a between line carrying a Peer moves the harm is slight, only obstruction and a loss of money, but if a between line carrying Pressure moves one is sure to be burdened and the harm is not slight. Juezi adds: when the between lines move, if the Day or Month clashes or controls them, the trouble can be resolved. The book's case: a proposal of marriage, the Wealth line on the Self line changing into Advancing, the Si Fire Output line moving to generate the Self line but turning back to be controlled, so one must wait for the Wu day to clash away the Zi Water while Wu Fire also combines with the Self line; the match is made, and it was agreed on the Wu day; someone asked whether the moving You Metal Pressure between line would not obstruct, and the answer was that Pressure turning into Retreating may obstruct but has no strength.

zh: 事阻隔兮间发。
yi: 事情有阻隔，是因为间爻发动。
en: The matter is obstructed when the between lines move.

zh: 旧注：世应中间两爻谓之间爻，动则事多阻隔。
谓此两爻，居世应之中，动阻两家之事，使彼此不能相通也。
又曰：世应中间两间爻发动，所求多阻隔。
yi: 旧注：世爻和应爻中间的两爻叫间爻，动了就多有阻隔。
是说这两爻位于世应中间，一动就阻隔两家的事，使双方不能互通。
又说：世应中间的两个间爻发动，所求的事多有阻隔。
en: Old commentary: the two lines between the Self and Other lines are called the between lines; when they move, the matter meets many obstructions.
That is, these two lines sit between the Self and Other lines, and when they move they block the affair of the two sides, so that the two cannot communicate.
It also says: when the two between lines between the Self and Other lines move, what is sought meets many obstructions.

zh: 觉子曰：以此两爻作为间爻，试之果验。
须看所占何事，惟彼此两家之事，始可用之。
如婚姻，以之为媒妁；
词讼，以之为中说；
买卖，以之为牙行；
借贷成交，以之为中保；
舟车，以之为附载；
交游，以之为帮闲；
胎产，以之为收生保母。
yi: 觉子说：把这两爻当作间爻，试了果然应验。
要看所占的是什么事，只有牵涉彼此两家的事，才可以用间爻。
比如婚姻，把它当作媒人；
诉讼，当作居中说合的人；
买卖，当作牙行（经纪）；
借贷成交，当作中间的保人；
舟车，当作同船同车搭载的人；
交朋友，当作帮闲的人；
生产，当作接生婆和保姆。
en: Juezi says: taking these two lines as the between lines, I tried it and it did prove true.
One must look at what is being divined; only a matter between two families or two sides can use them.
For marriage, take them as the go-between;
for a lawsuit, as the one who speaks between;
for a sale, as the broker;
for a loan agreed, as the guarantor between;
for a boat or carriage, as the one who rides along;
for friendships, as the hangers-on;
for childbirth, as the midwife and nurse.

zh: 野鹤曰：世为己，应为人，彼此欲相亲者，若遇间爻发动，不可概以阻隔断之，若得动而生合世应，反得此辈之力。
近世爻者，帮我之人也。
近应爻者，扶彼之人也。
生我者，我当亲之；
克我者，我宜远之。
独忌克乎世应，事必难成。
克我者，坏我之事，我被其愚；
克应者，坏彼之事，他为所诱。
若持史动，其害犹小，破阻其事，不过耗财而已；
若持鬼动，定受其累而为祸不浅也。
yi: 野鹤说：世爻是自己，应爻是别人，双方想要亲近的，如果遇到间爻发动，不可以一概断作阻隔；如果间爻动了去生合世爻和应爻，反而得到这些人的力量。
靠近世爻的，是帮我的人。
靠近应爻的，是扶助对方的人。
生我的，我应当亲近；
克我的，我应该远离。
最忌讳的是去克世爻和应爻，那样事情一定难成。
克我的，破坏我的事，我被他愚弄；
克应爻的，破坏对方的事，对方被他引诱。
如果间爻是兄弟（原文写作「史」）而动，害处还小，破坏阻碍这件事，不过耗些钱财罢了；
如果间爻是官鬼而动，一定受他连累，祸害不浅。
en: The Old Man of Yehe says: the Self line is oneself and the Other line is the other person; where two sides want to become close, if the between lines move, do not judge it all as obstruction; if they move to generate or combine with the Self and Other lines, one gains instead from the help of such people.
The one near the Self line is the person who helps me.
The one near the Other line is the person who supports the other side.
One that generates me I should draw near to;
one that controls me I should keep away from.
What is to be feared above all is one that controls the Self or Other line: then the matter is sure to be hard to make.
One that controls me spoils my affair and I am fooled by it;
one that controls the Other line spoils the other party's affair, and he is led astray by it.
If a between line carrying a Peer (the text writes 'shi', evidently a slip for 'xiong', Peer) moves, the harm is still slight: it breaks and blocks the affair, but no more than costing some money;
if a between line carrying Pressure moves, one will surely be burdened by it and the harm is not slight.

zh: 觉子曰：凡遇间爻动者，若得日月冲克，可解。
yi: 觉子说：凡是遇到间爻发动的，如果得到日辰、月建的冲克，可以化解。
en: Juezi says: whenever the between lines move, if they are clashed or controlled by the Day or Month, the trouble can be resolved.

zh: 又如：卯月乙丑日(旬空：戌亥)，占求婚成否？
得“噬嗑之比”
yi: 又一例：卯月乙丑日（旬空戌、亥），占求婚能不能成？
得噬嗑卦变比卦。
en: Another case: Mao month, Yichou day (void: Xu and Hai); a divination on whether a proposal of marriage would succeed.
The hexagram was Shihe changing into Bi.

zh: 财爻持世化进神，巳火子动而生世，但因巳火化子水回头之克，必待午日冲去子水，午火又合世爻，其婚必成。
果于午日允婚。
或曰：间爻酉金鬼动，岂无阻耶？
余曰：鬼化退神，虽有破阻，然而无力也。
yi: 财爻持世，化成进神；巳火子孙动了去生世爻，但是因为巳火变出子水，受了回头之克，必须等到午日冲去子水，午火又合住世爻，这门婚事就一定成。
果然在午日答应了婚事。
有人说：间爻酉金官鬼动了，难道没有阻碍吗？
我说：官鬼变成退神，虽然会有破坏阻碍，但是没有力量。
en: The Wealth line holds the Self line and changes into Advancing; the Si Fire Output line moves to generate the Self line, but because Si Fire changes into Zi Water, a returning control, one must wait for the Wu day to clash away the Zi Water, and Wu Fire also combines with the Self line; the marriage is sure to be made.
It was indeed on the Wu day that the match was agreed.
Someone said: the between line, You Metal Pressure, is moving; can there be no obstruction?
I said: Pressure turning into Retreating may indeed break and obstruct, but it has no strength.

dispute.yi: 旧注说间爻一动就多阻隔；野鹤明说不可一概这样断，间爻动而生合世应反得其力，只有克世、克应才是阻碍。觉子只说婚姻里间爻就是媒妁，没有说动了是吉是凶，又说日月冲克可以化解阻隔。书中例里间爻官鬼动，答的是鬼化退神，有阻而无力，和野鹤「看它生合还是克」是一路。
dispute.en: The old commentary says that when the between lines move there are many obstructions; the Old Man of Yehe says plainly that this is not to be judged across the board: between lines that move to generate or combine with the Self and Other lines help, and only those that control the Self or Other line obstruct. Juezi says only that in marriage the between lines are the go-betweens, without saying whether their moving is lucky or not, and adds that the Day or Month clashing or controlling them resolves the obstruction. In the book's case a moving Pressure between line is answered by 'Pressure turning into Retreating, obstructing but without strength', which is on the same road as the Old Man's 'look at whether it generates and combines or controls'.

note.yi: 这一条前半是《千金赋》「事阻隔兮间发」这一句以及注它的话，收在这里是因为觉子在同一处直接说到婚姻。野鹤那段里的「史」应是「兄」字之误（与下一句「持鬼」相对，兄弟爻动主耗财），译文按兄弟译，并在译文里注明。求婚的书中例出在进神退神章，不在千金赋一节，排盘图不收。
note.en: The first part of this entry is the Qianjin Fu line 'obstruction to the matter: the between lines move' and the comments on it; it is included because Juezi speaks directly of marriage at the same place. In the Old Man of Yehe's passage 'shi' is presumably a slip for 'xiong' (Peer), matching 'carrying Pressure' in the next sentence and the fact that a moving Peer means loss of money, and is translated as Peer, with a note in the translation. The proposal-of-marriage case comes from the chapter on Advancing and Retreating, not from the Qianjin Fu section, and its chart is not included.

units.chapter_en: Chapter on one's person and fate
units.title: 占身命不可一卦兼断：夫妻偕老要另占一卦；「兄动妻亡」这类一条通断，世上贫寒之士岂都是丧偶之人

rule.yi: 各书占身命，说妻子、钱财、儿女、官禄一个卦都能包，寿命长短、穷困通达六爻一起断。野鹤不同意：五个六亲各有互相忌讳互相伤害的地方，一个卦兼着断，就会出笑话——父母爻旺相说是「双庆」，又说「父旺伤子」，难道世上有父母的人都没有子嗣？兄弟爻旺持世，是克妻，是耗财，还是手足无伤？《易林补遗》说「兄动妻亡财耗散」，照这样断，世上的穷人和寒士岂不都是丧偶的人？觉子的办法是分开占：占父母、占兄弟各占一卦；终身的财福、终身的功名、夫妻能不能偕老、终身的子嗣和寿数，都应分开占。
rule.en: The books on divining one's person and fate say that wife, wealth, children and salary can all be covered by one hexagram, and length of life and poverty or success judged together from the six lines. The Old Man of Yehe disagrees: the five relations each have things that fear and harm one another, and judging them all together from one hexagram produces absurdities: a strong Resource line is called 'double celebration' and it is also said that 'a strong Resource harms Output', but is everyone in the world who has parents childless? A strong Peer line on the Self line: does it harm the wife, waste money, or leave the brothers unharmed? The Yilin Buyi says 'a moving Peer line: the wife dies and wealth is scattered'; holding to this, are all the poor and humble scholars of the world people who have lost their spouses? Juezi's method is to divine separately: one hexagram for parents and one for brothers; and lifelong wealth and fortune, lifelong office and fame, whether husband and wife will grow old together, and lifelong children and length of life should each be divined separately.

zh: 诸书占身命，谓妻财子禄，一卦能包，寿夭穷通，六爻兼断。
殊不知，父子财官兄弟，各有相忌相伤，若以一卦而兼断之，即如父母旺相，双庆之征，又曰：父旺伤子，岂世之有父母者，皆无子嗣之人耶？
又曰：见兄则财莫能聚，又为克妻之神，又曰：兄弟爻兴，紫荆并茂，倘值旺兄持世，克妻耶？
耗财耶？
手足无伤耶？
又《易林补遗》曰：“兄动妻亡财耗散”，执此论者，则世之贫人寒士，尽皆失偶之人耶？
至于财官子孙，皆同此论，不暇细辨。
必兼而断者，即先贤犹在，执此问之，恐亦无从置喙。
yi: 各书占身命，都说妻子、钱财、儿女、官禄，一个卦全能包括，寿命长短、穷困通达，六爻一起断。
殊不知父母、子孙、财、官、兄弟各有互相忌讳互相伤害的地方，如果用一个卦兼着断，比如父母爻旺相，说是「双庆」的征兆，又说「父旺伤子」，难道世上有父母的人，都是没有子嗣的人吗？
又说：见到兄弟爻，钱财就聚不起来，兄弟又是克妻的神；又说：兄弟爻兴旺，像紫荆花一样并茂。如果遇到旺相的兄弟爻持世，是克妻呢？
还是耗财呢？
或者手足没有伤害呢？
又有《易林补遗》说：「兄动妻亡财耗散」，照这个说法，那么世上的穷人和寒士，岂不都是丧偶的人？
至于财、官、子孙，道理都一样，来不及一一细辨。
一定要合起来断的话，就是先贤还在，拿这个去问他们，恐怕也无话可说。
en: The books that divine one's person and fate all say that wife, wealth, children and salary can be covered by one hexagram, and length of life, poverty and success judged together from the six lines.

They do not realize that Resource, Output, Wealth, Pressure and Peer each have things that fear and harm one another; if all are judged together from one hexagram, take the Resource line strong: it is called a sign of double celebration, and it is also said that 'a strong Resource harms Output'; does that mean everyone in the world who has parents is childless?

It is also said that where a Peer line appears wealth cannot gather and Peer is the spirit that harms the wife; and it is also said that when the Peer line flourishes, brothers flourish together like the bauhinia; suppose a strong Peer line holds the Self line: does it harm the wife?
Or does it waste money?
Or is there no harm to the brothers?
And the Yilin Buyi says: 'A moving Peer line, the wife dies and wealth is scattered.' Holding to this, are all the poor and humble scholars of the world people who have lost their spouses?
As for Wealth, Pressure and Output, the same argument applies to all, and there is no time to go into each.
As for insisting on judging them all together, were the worthies of old still alive and asked this, I fear even they would have nothing to say.

zh: 觉子曰：余今得其法者，乃分占之法也。
占父母、占兄弟，各占一卦。
占终身财福何如？
占终身功名有无？
占夫妻偕老否？
占终身子嗣及寿元，俱宜分占。
yi: 觉子说：我现在得到的办法，是分开来占的办法。
占父母的、占兄弟的，各自占一卦。
占一生的财运福气怎么样？
占一生的功名有没有？
占夫妻能不能白头偕老？
占一生的子嗣和寿数，都应该分开占。
en: Juezi says: the method I have now found is the method of dividing the divinations.
To divine parents and to divine brothers, cast one hexagram for each.
Divining lifelong wealth and fortune: what are they like?
Divining lifelong office and fame: will there be any?
Divining whether husband and wife will grow old together?
Divining lifelong children and length of life: all should be divined separately.

zh: 兄爻临世，财耗贫寒。
旧系“遇兄，则财莫能聚“。
解注有云：“世遇兄爻，必克妻妾，一生必不聚财。”
既以为克妻，又以为破耗，执此而论，世之伤妻者，皆贫困之人也。
假使贫者偕老，富者断弦，何以决之？
故余以分占为得理。
yi: 兄弟爻临在世爻上，钱财耗散，贫寒。
旧书里说：「遇到兄弟，钱财就聚不起来。」
解注说：「世爻遇到兄弟爻，一定克妻妾，一生一定聚不起钱财。」
既然认为克妻，又认为破耗，照这样说，世上伤了妻子的人，都是贫困的人了。
假使穷人白头偕老，富人却断了弦，又怎么解释？
所以我认为分开占才合道理。
en: A Peer line on Self: wealth wasted, poverty.
The old saying is: 'meeting a Peer line, wealth cannot gather.'
The commentary says: 'When Self meets a Peer line it must control wife and concubines, and in a whole life wealth surely will not gather.'
Since it is taken both as harming the wife and as wasting wealth, by that reasoning all the people in the world who have lost a wife are poor.
Suppose the poor grow old together while the rich lose their wives: how would that be explained?
So I hold that divining separately is what accords with reason.

dispute.yi: 野鹤批评的是「诸书」的一卦兼断，其中特别点了《易林补遗》一句「兄动妻亡财耗散」。这句在本库的《易林补遗》里没有原样出现，意思相近的是「兄动，妻灾奴仆患，资财耗散事无成」（该书第 109 行）和「兄动损妻，财无积聚」（第 441 行），应是转述。
dispute.en: What the Old Man of Yehe criticizes is judging everything from one hexagram as 'the books' do, and he singles out the Yilin Buyi line 'a moving Peer line, the wife dies and wealth is scattered'. That sentence does not appear word for word in the Yilin Buyi in this library; the close ones are 'Peer moving: trouble for wife and servants, wealth scattered and nothing accomplished' (line 109 of that book) and 'Peer moving harms the wife, wealth does not gather' (line 441), so it is presumably a paraphrase.

note.yi: 原文「父子财官兄弟」列的是五个六亲，译文写作 Resource、Output、Wealth、Pressure、Peer；「紫荆并茂」用的是三兄弟分家、紫荆枯死又复荣的典故，意思是兄弟和睦兴旺。
note.en: The text's 'father, sons, Wealth, Pressure, brothers' lists the five relations, translated as Resource, Output, Wealth, Pressure and Peer; 'bauhinia flourishing together' alludes to the story of three brothers who divided the estate, whereupon the bauhinia tree withered and revived when they reunited, and means brothers in concord and prosperity.

units.title: 三合成局吉凶各有所宜：占婚姻、夫妇宜财官旺而合局，占久远喜庆之事宜成局；用神旺、世爻在局或局生世才吉，局克世则凶

rule.yi: 申子辰合水局、巳酉丑合金局、寅午戌合火局、亥卯未合木局；三合有四种成局的方式，有吉有凶。占祖坟、家宅，宜父母爻合成局；占婚姻、夫妇，宜财官旺而合成局；占长久的喜庆事，宜成局，永远牢固；占官司、忧疑的事而成局，一辈子心里结着解不开的结。用三合局要看条件：用神旺就无不吉，世爻在局里最好；世爻不在局里，局也要生世爻才断吉；局克世爻，按凶推。日建、月建有一个在局里，叫局旺，更吉。三爻只有两爻动不算成局，要等以后的月日补上，叫虚一待用；一爻明动一爻暗动也算两爻动；局中有一爻逢空、破的，等填实的日月才成；有一爻入墓的，等冲开墓的日子才成。
rule.en: Shen-Zi-Chen combine into a Water frame, Si-You-Chou into Metal, Yin-Wu-Xu into Fire and Hai-Mao-Wei into Wood; a three-harmony frame can form in four ways, and includes ill ones and auspicious ones. For ancestral graves and the household, it suits the Resource line forming a frame; for marriage and husband and wife, it suits Wealth and Pressure being strong and forming a frame; for a long-lasting celebration, forming a frame suits and is firm forever; for a lawsuit or a matter of worry and doubt, a frame that forms leaves a knot in the heart for life. How to use a three-harmony frame depends on conditions: with a strong Subject none fails to be auspicious, and best is the Self line inside the frame; if the Self line is outside, the frame must generate the Self line before it is judged auspicious; if the frame controls the Self line, reckon it ill. If the Day or Month is inside the frame it is called a strong frame, better still. If only two of the three lines move it is not a formed frame, and one waits for a later month or day to supply the third, which is called 'leaving one empty, awaiting use'; one line moving openly and one moving in secret counts as two moving; if one line of the frame is Void or broken, it forms on the day or month that fills it; if one has entered a tomb, it forms on the day that clashes the tomb open.

zh: 申子辰合成水局。
巳酉丑合成金局。
寅午戌合成火局。
亥卯未合成木局。
此三合者有四：一卦之内，有三爻动而合局者，一也。
两爻动，一爻不动，亦成合局者，二也。
有内卦初爻、三爻动，动而变出之爻成三合者，三也。
有外卦四爻、六爻动，动而变出之爻成三合者，四也。
余按：此三合局者，有凶有吉。
yi: 申、子、辰三支合成水局。
巳、酉、丑三支合成金局。
寅、午、戌三支合成火局。
亥、卯、未三支合成木局。
三合有四种：一个卦里，有三爻都动而合成局的，是第一种。
两爻动、一爻不动，也能合成局的，是第二种。
内卦初爻、三爻动，动了变出来的爻成三合的，是第三种。
外卦四爻、六爻动，动了变出来的爻成三合的，是第四种。
我按：这三合局，有凶的也有吉的。
en: Shen, Zi and Chen combine into a Water frame.
Si, You and Chou combine into a Metal frame.
Yin, Wu and Xu combine into a Fire frame.
Hai, Mao and Wei combine into a Wood frame.
There are four kinds of three-harmony: within one hexagram, three lines moving and combining into a frame is the first.
Two lines moving and one still, which also form a frame, is the second.
Where the first and third lines of the inner trigram move and the lines they change into form a three-harmony, is the third.
Where the fourth and sixth lines of the outer trigram move and the lines they change into form a three-harmony, is the fourth.
My note: these three-harmony frames include ill ones and auspicious ones.

zh: 占祖茔、家宅，宜父母爻而合局；
占婚姻、夫妇，宜财官旺而合局。
占久远喜庆之事，宜于成局，永远坚牢；
若占官讼、忧疑事而合局者，终身锢结其心，难于消释。
yi: 占祖坟、家宅，宜于父母爻合成局；
占婚姻、夫妇，宜于财官旺而合成局。
占长久的喜庆之事，宜于成局，永远牢固；
如果占官司、忧虑疑惑的事而合成局，一辈子心里结着解不开的结，难以消除。
en: For ancestral graves and the household, it suits the Resource line forming a frame;
for marriage and husband and wife, it suits Wealth and Pressure being strong and forming a frame.
For a long-lasting celebration, forming a frame suits, and it is firm forever;
if one divines a lawsuit or a matter of worry and doubt and a frame forms, the heart is bound for life and the knot is hard to loosen.

zh: 但三合其局者，用神旺，则无不为吉，尤要世爻在局为美。
若世爻不在局内，亦须局生世爻，始以吉断。
倘局克世爻，则以凶推。
至于日建月建，但有一在局中，谓之局旺，更吉。
三爻若只两爻动，不为成局。
须待后来之月日补凑，合成其局，谓之虚一待用。
一爻明动，一爻暗动，亦作两爻动。
三合局中，有一值空破者，待填实之日月成之。
有一爻入墓者，待冲开之日成之。
yi: 不过三合成局的，用神旺，就没有不吉的，尤其要世爻在局里才好。
如果世爻不在局里，也必须局去生世爻，才断作吉。
如果局克世爻，就按凶来推。
至于日建、月建，只要有一个在局里，叫做局旺，更吉。
三个爻如果只有两爻动，不算成局。
必须等以后的月、日把缺的补上，合成这个局，叫做「虚一待用」。
一爻明动、一爻暗动，也算作两爻动。
三合局中，有一个爻逢空、破的，等填实的日、月才成。
有一个爻入墓的，等冲开墓的日子才成。
en: But where a three-harmony frame forms and the Subject is strong, none fails to be auspicious, and it is best that the Self line be inside the frame.
If the Self line is not inside the frame, the frame must still generate the Self line before it is judged auspicious.
If the frame controls the Self line, reckon it ill.
As for the Day and the Month, if either one is within the frame it is called a strong frame, and better still.
If of the three lines only two move, it does not count as a formed frame.
One must wait for a later month or day to supply what is missing and complete the frame; this is called 'leaving one empty, awaiting use'.
One line moving openly and one moving in secret also counts as two lines moving.
If one of the lines within a three-harmony frame is Void or broken, the frame forms on the day or month that fills it.
If one line has entered a tomb, it forms on the day that clashes the tomb open.

note.yi: 同一段里还有占功名（官局）和占求财（财局、子孙局生财）的断语，那是别的问题域的内容，这里不收。「虚一待用」是说三爻里缺一个，先空着，等月日来补。
note.en: The same paragraph also has entries on fame (the Pressure frame) and on seeking wealth (a Wealth frame, an Output frame generating Wealth); those belong to other domains and are not included. 'Leaving one empty, awaiting use' means one of the three is missing and left open until a month or day supplies it.

units.chapter: 婚姻章·此婚子嗣有无章
units.chapter_en: Marriage chapter: whether this marriage will have children
units.title: 此婚子嗣有无：子孙旺相或休囚而动、动而化吉皆主有子，化进神回头生有子必多；子孙墓绝、动变鬼、鬼变子孙、父化子子化父父动克子，是我命无儿，成此婚与否也无子，惟多积阴德以培之

rule.yi: 问这门婚事将来有没有子嗣：子孙爻旺相，或者休囚了但动，以及动而化吉的，都主有子；子孙化出进神、化出回头生的，有子一定多。如果子孙爻墓、绝，或者动而变成官鬼，官鬼变成子孙，父化子孙、子孙化父，父动克子孙，都是因为我命里没有儿子，成这门婚也好、不成也好，都没有子嗣；只有多积阴德来培补。书中例：申月丁丑日，因为妾多，占谁的命里有儿子，得革之夬，断为卯木子孙绝在申月、鬼变子孙又逢月破，是这位先生自己的命里没有儿子，与女子的命无关；从八字看也是无子。劝他多积阴德，此后他施舍济贫、成全人的夫妇、修桥铺路、舍药施棺，接连生了两个儿子。
rule.en: Asking whether this marriage will have children: if the Output line is strong, or resting but moving, or moves and changes into good, there will be a son; if Output changes into an Advancing spirit or into a returning generation, there will surely be many. If the Output line meets tomb or extinction, or moves and changes into Pressure, or Pressure changes into Output, or Resource and Output change into each other, or a moving Resource line controls Output, it is because my own fate has no son, and whether or not this marriage is made there will be no child; the only remedy is to pile up hidden merit. The book's case: in a Shen month on a Dingchou day, because he had many concubines, a man divined whose fate would bear a son and got Ge changing into Guai; it was judged that the Mao-wood Output line is in extinction in the Shen month and Pressure changes into Output while meeting the Month-break, so the gentleman's own fate has no son and it has nothing to do with the women's fates; his birth chart also showed no son. He was urged to pile up hidden merit; after that he gave alms to the poor, helped couples in their marriages, mended bridges and roads and gave out medicine and coffins, and had two sons in a row.

zh: 子孙旺相，或休囚而动，及动而化吉，皆主有子；
子化进神，化回头生，有子必多。
如逢子孙墓绝，动而变鬼，鬼变子孙，父化子、子化父、父动克子，皆因我命无儿，成此婚与否，亦无子也。
惟多积阴德以培之。
yi: 子孙爻旺相，或者休囚了但动，以及动而化吉，都主有子；
子孙化出进神，化出回头生，有子一定多。
如果遇到子孙墓、绝，动而变成官鬼，官鬼变成子孙，父化子孙、子孙化父，父动克子孙，都是因为我命里没有儿子，成这门婚不成这门婚，也都没有子嗣。
只有多积阴德来培补。
en: If the Output line is strong, or resting but moving, or moves and changes into good, it means there will be a son;
if Output changes into an Advancing spirit or into a returning generation, there will surely be many sons.

If the Output line meets tomb or extinction, or moves and changes into Pressure, or Pressure changes into Output, or Resource and Output change into each other, or a moving Resource line controls Output, it is all because my fate has no son: whether or not this marriage is made, there will be no child.
Only by piling up hidden merit can it be nurtured.

zh: 如：申月丁丑日(旬空：申酉)，因多妾，占何命者有子，得“革之夬”
yi: 比如：申月丁丑日（旬空：申、酉），因为妾多，占哪一个人的命里有儿子，得革卦变夬卦。
en: For example: in a Shen month on a Dingchou day (void: Shen and You), because he had many concubines, a divination on whose fate would bear a son, and the hexagram was Ge changing into Guai.

zh: 断曰：卯木子孙，绝于申月，鬼变子孙，又逢月破，公命无子，与女命无干也。
即出八字观之：甲寅、甲戌、甲子、戊辰，余曰：“八字虽奇，纯阳包阴，兵权显赫。
但嫌平头煞重，叠叠魁罡，亦主无子。”
公曰：“有何法耶？”
余曰：“多积阴德以培之。”
公曰：“不孝有三，无后为大。”
嗣后施济贫寒，全人夫妇，修桥砌路，舍药施棺，遂连生二子。
临终嘱其子曰：“我非阴功，不能有尔，尔若成人，多宜积德。”
yi: 断：卯木子孙爻，在申月绝，官鬼变出子孙，又逢月破，是先生您的命里没有儿子，和女子的命无关。
又拿他的八字来看：甲寅、甲戌、甲子、戊辰，我说：「八字虽然奇特，是纯阳包着阴，兵权显赫。
但是嫌它平头煞重，重重叠叠的魁罡，也主无子。」
先生说：「有什么办法吗？」
我说：「多积阴德来培补。」
先生说：「不孝有三，无后为大。」
此后他施舍救济贫寒的人，成全别人的夫妇，修桥铺路，舍药施棺，于是接连生了两个儿子。
临终嘱咐他的儿子说：「我不是靠阴功，是不能有你们的；你如果成人，要多多积德。」
en: Verdict: the Mao-wood Output line is in extinction in the Shen month, Pressure changes into Output, and it also meets the Month-break: the gentleman's own fate has no son, and it has nothing to do with the women's fates.
Then his birth chart was looked at: Jiayin, Jiaxu, Jiazi, Wuchen; I said: 'The chart is remarkable, pure yang enclosing yin, with great military authority.
But it is troubled by heavy flat-head killing stars and layer upon layer of the Kuigang stars, which also means no son.'
The gentleman said: 'Is there any remedy?'
I said: 'Pile up hidden merit to nurture it.'
The gentleman said: 'There are three kinds of unfilial conduct, and having no heir is the worst.'
After that he gave alms to the poor, helped couples in their marriages, mended bridges and roads and gave out medicine and coffins, and so had two sons in a row.
On his deathbed he charged his son: 'Had I not done hidden good, I could not have had you; when you are grown, be sure to pile up merit.'

note.yi: 「公」是来占的先生；「公命无子，与女命无干」是说没有儿子出在他自己的命上，不是哪个妾的问题。「平头煞」「魁罡」是八字里的凶煞，书里没有解释；「全人夫妇」大概是成全别人夫妻的事（如劝和、周济），这里译得宽一些。这一章还有一条「［乾按］」是今人的话，不收。
note.en: 'Gong' is the gentleman who came to divine; 'the gentleman's own fate has no son, and it has nothing to do with the women's fates' says the lack of a son lies in his own fate and not in any one concubine. 'Flat-head killing star' and 'Kuigang' are ill stars in the birth chart, which the book does not explain; 'helping couples' probably means helping other people's marriages, such as reconciling or relieving them, and is translated broadly here. One further note in this chapter, marked 'Qian an', is a modern comment and is not included.

units.title: 用神动而化墓：墓者滞也，婚姻遇之迟滞难成，大抵皆暗昧不明之象；墓神回头克动爻则是凶兆

rule.yi: 用神动了变出墓，墓就是滞：病、捕获、身命、失物、婚姻遇到都是暗昧不明的象。落在婚姻上，是拖延停滞、难以成就。但如果动爻化墓，而墓神又回头来克动爻，就不要当作暗昧昏滞来断，那是凶兆；要是墓神本身是官鬼，回头克用神，更凶。
rule.en: When the Subject moves and changes into tomb, tomb means stagnation: illness, capture, life and fate, lost goods and marriage all become obscure and unclear. For a marriage it means delay and stagnation, and it is hard to accomplish. But if a moving line changes into tomb and the tomb spirit turns back to control the moving line, it should not be judged as mere obscurity and stagnation, for that is an ill omen; and if the tomb spirit is Pressure itself, turning back to control the Subject, it is worse.

zh: 养主狐疑，墓多暧昧。
yi: 十二长生里，「养」这一位主疑惑不决，「墓」这一位多是暧昧不明。
en: Among the twelve growth stages, the nurturing state means doubt and hesitation, and the tomb state much that is obscure.

zh: 墓者，滞也，用神动而化墓者，
yi: 墓就是滞，用神动了变成墓的，
en: Tomb means stagnation: where the Subject moves and changes into tomb,

zh: 捕获遇之，深藏难觅；
身命遇之，愚蒙不振；
失脱遇之，暗藏不见；
婚姻遇之，迟滞难成，大抵皆暗昧不明之象也。
yi: 捕获遇到它，深藏难找；
占身命遇到它，愚昧蒙昧，不得振作；
失物遇到它，暗暗藏着看不见；
婚姻遇到它，拖延停滞、难以成就，大体上都是暗昧不明的象。
en: in a capture it is deeply hidden and hard to find;
in life and fate it is dull and benighted with no stirring;
in lost goods it lies hidden and unseen;
in a marriage there is delay and stagnation and it is hard to accomplish, and in general all of it is an image of obscurity and unclearness.

zh: 如若动爻化墓，而墓神回头克动爻，勿以暗昧昏滞而论，乃凶兆也，忌回头之克我者是也。
如若墓神为鬼，回头克用，更凶。
yi: 如果动爻化成墓，而墓神回头来克动爻，不要当作暗昧昏滞来断，那是凶兆，忌讳的就是回头来克我的。
如果墓神是官鬼，回头克用神，更凶。
en: If a moving line changes into tomb and the tomb spirit turns back to control the moving line, do not judge it as obscurity and stagnation: it is an ill omen, and what is feared is the one that turns back to control me.
If the tomb spirit is Pressure and turns back to control the Subject, it is worse.

note.yi: 「养主狐疑，墓多暧昧」是十二长生里养、墓两位的老话；作者说他只验生、旺、墓、绝四位，养、病、胎、沐浴在动变里都删了，这里只取墓。这一段是总说，病、捕获、身命、失物、婚姻并列，只有「婚姻遇之，迟滞难成」一句专讲婚姻。「用」这里是用神。
note.en: 'Nurturing means doubt, tomb means much obscurity' is an old saying about two of the twelve growth stages, nurturing and tomb; the author says he has found only the four states of birth, prosperity, tomb and extinction to hold true, and has dropped nurturing, sickness, womb and bathing from changed lines, so only tomb is taken here. This passage is a general statement, listing illness, capture, life and fate, lost goods and marriage side by side, and only 'in a marriage it means delay and stagnation' speaks of marriage in particular. 'The Subject' translates 'yong' here.
